scope: Local development regression139 and consolidation140 before candidate version bump

method.regression: One full frontend campaign and one Rust workspace campaign; resume previously unexecuted integration targets after Cargo fail-fast; rerun failed or invalidated cases only
method.evidenceAuthority: Existing logs and the final verification DTO are summarized, not rerun by this consolidation audit
method.sourceSnapshotAuthority: Working-tree bytes captured at consolidation after successful regression. This is a new reproducibility baseline, not a retroactive complete input manifest for the earlier campaign. The prior frontend performance source manifest has been compared for all seven recorded files.
method.sourceHashAlgorithm: sha256 of raw working-tree file bytes; line-ending normalization in Git may change raw hashes
method.sourceTreeHashAlgorithm: sha256 of sorted UTF-8 records: repository-relative path, NUL, hex sha256, newline
method.reusePolicy: Reuse unaffected regression results for consolidation/documentation/version changes; rebuild changed packaging inputs and validate the installed candidate. If product behavior, dependencies, feature flags or relevant environment changes, repeat focused checks that those changes invalidate. Do not label an installed-candidate check complete from these source tests.

normalizationAfterAudit.reason: Only redundant terminal blank lines removed and one equivalent Rust whitespace literal written with explicit escapes; no behavior or dependency change; no full regression repeated.

limitations: Original detailed logs, source measurements, screenshots and APK/installer binaries remain under ignored output/build areas and are not part of a clean Git clone. This tracked receipt contains summaries and hashes only.
No complete retroactive source hash manifest is claimed for the original full regression.
No GitHub Actions, installation, real-device/human acceptance, public update endpoint or real AI evaluation is certified here.
